candidates.snippet: Ukrainian long-range strikes hit an enterprise and an oil facility in Saratov and Volgograd regions, with more hits in the Black Sea, Zelensky said. Strikes also targeted Dagestan, Udmurtia, Tula, Nizhny Novgorod, Perm, and Samara regions. https://t.co/gqBVpJsKWB

Ukrainian forces struck several key Russian military targets, according to the General Staff:
• Two Pantsir-S1 systems in Taganrog, Rostov region
• A radar station in Berezki, Bryansk region
• A drone launch and storage site in Donetsk
• An Akhmat drone training center in

An Ozon warehouse near Saratov burned to the ground following a strike. The logistics facility covered roughly 100,000 square meters. This is the seventh Ozon warehouse damaged or destroyed since August 22. https://t.co/TGFaEDhc2h https://t.co/vJD7esqMeo
